gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-momo-trust-sans: Momo Trust Sans reads friendly and unfussy, with round bowls as sturdy as its stems. Pixelify Sans brings the blocky, expressive punch up top, and that jump from loud to welcoming is the best thing about the pair.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-mona-sans: Pixelify Sans draws its pixel letters with a constant-width line you could trace with a finger. Mona Sans follows in a sans-serif with wide, doorway-like openings, so the loud top line and the quiet text never compete.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-monda: Approachable describes Monda, and it shows. Pixelify Sans is best at bold, pixel-built uppercase that grabs attention, while Monda is best at keeping its small counters open and easy to follow.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-mooli: Pixelify Sans has no thick-and-thin contrast to slow the eye, just a bold, expressive line from end to end. Mooli, the sans-serif below, keeps its round letters open and clear.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-murecho: Pixelify Sans holds one stroke width throughout, and that is what makes it bold and expressive in display sizes. Murecho handles the quieter job, with s curves that open wide at both ends so running text goes down smoothly.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-nanum-gothic: Pipe-cleaner pixels, loud and bold. Nanum Gothic, a sans-serif with wide channels leading into each counter, would carry a long passage smoothly and professionally under Pixelify Sans.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-national-park: Pixelify Sans is the bold one here, a pixel display face with a constant line weight and a c open like a bent paperclip. And National Park, a sans-serif drawn as if with a pen that never shifts pressure, would read in a long passage with rounded, clearly open letters.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-niramit: Blocky, bold and hairline-free. Niramit's gaping curves give the sans-serif text a professional ease, and the heading probably looks best at a much larger size than the body.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-noto-sans-canadi: Expressive is the mood up top, where Pixelify Sans keeps a steady line with no thick-thin swing. Its strongest quality against Noto Sans Canadian Aboriginal is that loud-versus-plain split, since the plain sans below stays open at every curve end.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-noto-sans-cyprio: Pixelify Sans is all bold pixel shapes, with lines no heavier on the downstrokes. Noto Sans Cypriot keeps a long passage approachable, its e opening up instead of closing its eye.
